Class PartyHud

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.PartyHud
public final class PartyHud extends Object
The party frames on the screen (API version 25): each member's name, health, stamina and how far away they are, under the party's name with an optional line and bar (a level, a goal). Core draws them, in its own HUD, where and how each player chose (/partyhud); a plugin with parties only says who is in the viewer's party. One source at a time, as with Claims: Tempest Claims is it when it runs. 
core.partyHud(viewer -> {
    MyParty party = parties.of(viewer);
    return party == null ? null : new PartyHud.Party(party.name(), "#E05050", members(party),
            Message.raw("Level 6 · 1,240 / 2,000"), 0.62f);
});

    PartyHud.Member
    One member: who, the name to show, and a short tag after it ("Owner", or null).
    static final record 
    PartyHud.Party
    The viewer's party: its name and colour ("#RRGGBB"), its members in the order to show them (the viewer included; Core leaves them out unless the player wants to see themselves), a line under the name (or null) and a bar from 0 to 1 under that line (below 0: no bar).
    static interface 
    PartyHud.Source
    Answers, from memory and quickly, which party a player is in.
